svg.title: Missing component: potential causes
svg.desc: Training analysis. Source branch order and causal arrows preserved. Top branches left to right: Environment, People, Materials. Bottom branches left to right: Methods, Equipment. Potential causes are hypotheses for investigation.

text.tspan: High temperature changes the solder paste
Omissions or errors in manual placement of
Foreign matter or paint on PCB pads
Exposed copper or oxidation on the
Bent, blocked or worn placement nozzle,
Placement coordinate errors or incorrect Z axis settings
